tickets.title: [Major] A listening agent on a zero-point routine can never finish - stuck "listening" forever
tickets.name: D-03 [Needs re-verification] [Major] A listening agent on a zero-point routine can never finish - stuck "listening" forever
tickets.notes:
Area: Agent lifecycle / RoutineFocus.countTaskCompleted · Found: day 1 · Priority: P1

REPRO
Preconditions: A routine item whose stimulus points are 0 (card shows e.g. "Geniuses +0"), with an agent that has both a start and an end event.
1. Focus the 0-point routine (deck). 2. Tap the ring -> START AGENT. 3. Wait for the start event to return 200 and the stage to become `listening`. 4. Complete every item on that routine's checklist (header reaches "2 of 2 done"). 5. Wait; reload; reopen the app on later days.

EXPECTED
With every checklist item done the end event fires, the agent reaches `finished` and the result is shown.

ACTUAL
The end event never fires. agentStage stays `listening`, the top bar keeps a permanent `hearing` badge, /agents keeps reporting "1 live now", and the agent cannot be run again. Still `listening` 5 simulated days and 5 browser sessions later.

At 2 of 2 done: vm.countTaskTotal(task) = 1 but vm.countTaskCompleted(task) = 0, with task.points = 0 and K.earned = 0. apps/web-app/src/pages/RoutineFocus.vue countTaskCompleted(): `if (!total || !k || !task.points) return 0;` - a 0-point routine short-circuits to 0 and can never reach total, so maybeFireAgentEndEvent's `completed < total` guard never clears. Cross-check on a second routine: on Wind-down (points 5) completing one checklist item moved K.earned 2.5 -> 3.333 and the slot counter 3 -> 4, so the mechanism works whenever points > 0.
Screenshot: C:/Users/grvpa/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/D--Documents-Projects-family-routine/ada490d7-ccbc-40e2-921e-6b447730d776/scratchpad/d1-07-reviewpayment-missed.png

Starting an agent on a routine item with points = 0 and then completing all of that routine's day goal items fires the end event and the agent reaches `finished` (or the UI refuses to start an agent on a 0-point routine and says why). No agent is left in `listening` with every item complete.

tickets.title: Routine chat cannot create tasks and reports success anyway - every add_tasks path fails server-side once a routine has a week goal
tickets.name: D-01 [Critical] Routine chat cannot create tasks and reports success anyway - every add_tasks path fails server-side once a routine has a week goal
tickets.notes:
Area: Routine chat / RoutineChatContainer.createItems -> addGoalItem · Found: day 1 · Priority: P0

REPRO
Preconditions: Phone shell, /home, a focused routine whose day goal items carry a goalRef. Because resolveDayGoalLink in apps/server/src/resolvers/goal.js auto-links every day goal of a routine that has a week goal ("OWNER RULE: a day goal is ALWAYS linked to the week goal of its routine"), this is the default state for any user with week goals - it is not specific to the AI builder.
1. Focus a routine that has a week goal. 2. Type "Add a task: Draft the beta v2 scope doc" into composer-input and send. 3. Read the reply bubble. 4. Read the checklist header and rows. 5. Reload /home and read them again. Repeat with the brief card's NEXT STEPS "Add" button and with chat `break_down` -> "Add all to checklist".

EXPECTED
The item is created as a day goal under the focused routine, appears in the checklist, and the reply bubble renders a live checkbox for it (as it does on a routine whose items have no goalRef).

ACTUAL
Nothing is created. The bubble still says "Added 'Draft the beta v2 scope doc' to your checklist." with no live checkbox and no `N tasks added` event pill. The brief card's Add button flips to a disabled "Added" tick for an item that does not exist. "Add all to checklist" silently drops all three proposals. Reproduced 6+ times on days 1, 2 and 6.

EVIDENCE
Console (repeatable, 3 lines per attempt): `Goal mutation error (addGoalItem): Error: GraphQL error: When goalRef is provided, isMilestone must be true` and `[RoutineChat] createItems failed: Error: GraphQL error: When goalRef is provided, isMilestone must be true`. Source: apps/web-app/src/containers/RoutineChatContainer.vue createItems() sends `goalRef: inheritedGoalRef()` together with `isMilestone: false`; apps/server/src/resolvers/goal.js:1477 throws `if (goalRef && !isMilestone)`. Cross-checked on a second surface: with the SAME routine and the SAME goalRef, the checklist's "Add task" row (AiSearchModal) created "Write the beta v2 scope doc" successfully (header 4 of 5 -> 4 of 6), so the server and the goalRef are fine and the fault is in the chat's create path.
Screenshot: C:/Users/grvpa/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/D--Documents-Projects-family-routine/ada490d7-ccbc-40e2-921e-6b447730d776/scratchpad/d2-01-brief-false-added.png, d6-01-addall-silent-fail.png

DONE WHEN
On a routine whose day goals already carry a goalRef, sending "add a task: X" in the routine chat creates X, X appears in the checklist immediately and after a reload, the reply bubble renders a live checkbox for X, and no addGoalItem error appears in the console. The same holds for the brief card's NEXT STEPS "Add" and for "Add all to checklist". If a create does fail, the bubble says so instead of claiming "Added".
